# Bryan Fangman

> Technology, safety and security leader working where Physical AI is converging: safety-critical systems, autonomous operations, cybersecurity, enterprise governance and agentic AI. Based in Orlando, Florida.

Background: U.S. Army attack-helicopter pilot and Battalion Safety Officer (Captain, O-3), Lockheed Martin security architecture and technology governance, and enterprise software product leadership (Borland / Micro Focus). Owner / Broker of Precision Approach Realty, LLC; Owner / Founder of Taskonomy LLC; President of Metropolitan at Lake Eola Condominium Association.

Credentials: B.S., United States Military Academy, West Point · Florida Real Estate Broker · Licensed Community Association Manager (LCAM) · FAA Commercial Pilot, Rotorcraft-Helicopter/Instrument · Lockheed Martin Patent Award (2009).
